model.dispatch: Events are observed by polling proven game state once per update tick (no code patches). Everything observed in one tick is dispatched after all sources are polled, in source order, then by subscriber priority (higher first) and subscription order.
model.isolation: Every callback runs isolated. A failure is logged with the mod, the event and the error; the other subscribers still run. max_failures consecutive failures (default 25, 0 = never) disable that subscription.
model.phases: post: the game already applied it; the payload is a snapshot and mutating it changes nothing. pre: delivered before the game applies it and may be mutated (none are available). state: a state transition.
model.causes: cause.source is 'native' for gameplay, or 'mod' for an action a mod performed through Runtime (cause.mod, cause.action, cause.depth). Runtime refuses actions deeper than 4 mod-caused links.
model.mission: mission_started / mission_ended bracket a mission. Mission-scoped subscriptions, timers and mod.mission state end with the mission, after mission_ended is dispatched, and every handle from that mission becomes invalid.

sources.input: Bound keys, polled only while the game window has focus.
sources.game_state: The game's state machine: its Mission state with a game_mode object, and this peer's authority over it (host).
sources.players: The game's player list: peer ids, lifecycle state, and each avatar entity (through the network id map).
sources.health: One bulk scan per tick of the health manager: every entity with a HealthComponent, its health, life state (alive, downed, dead) and last-hit creditor. When a tracked record disappears, the corpse manager is read once: the game replaces a dead entity by a corpse entity that takes over its unit and names the dead entity, so a death that happened between two polls is still reported.
sources.stats: The local player's mission stats as the game keeps them: the main table plus one block per source type (the weapon, throwable or stratagem payload the game recorded the stat under), checked 10 times per second.
sources.weapons: What the local player's avatar holds: its wielder slot 0 (the entity in hand) and the inventory selection the game's weapon switch writes in the same call, checked 10 times per second.

The game adds it in its projectile system, once per projectile that hits, under the weapon that fired it. Checked 10 times per second, so one event can count several hits. Local player only. Thrown entities such as the K-2 Throwing Knife are not projectile-system projectiles: use player_damage_dealt for them.

events.name: player_damage_dealt
events.summary: The local player dealt damage: the game's dealt_damage mission stat grew by the damage the game recorded, under the weapon, throwable or stratagem payload that dealt it (team damage is a separate stat and is not counted). Checked 10 times per second: `damage` is the sum since the previous check. A hit that the target's armor stops entirely records nothing. Follow-up damage the game credits to the same source (an explosion, a status) is counted under that source too; no per-hit victim is reported.

events.name: entity_damage_pre
events.reason: A pre-damage callback would have to run inside the native damage path before it applies (game.dll 0x9235F0). Runtime patches no game code, and nothing read at damage time can scale one attacker's or one weapon's damage: every multiplier there is global (Vitality, the relation table, mission modifiers) or belongs to the target (research/event-combat-F5FEE03DCFDB.json). Observe damage with entity_damaged.

Consecutive failures before the subscription is disabled (default 25, 0 = never).

HD2ActionHandle.doc: A gameplay action a mod requested. A refusal never raises: status is refused with a code and a reason.
fields: requested: the game accepted the request this frame.

Why it was refused (UNKNOWN_EXPLOSION, UNKNOWN_PROJECTILE, UNKNOWN_STATUS, ASSET_UNKNOWN, ASSET_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_IN_MISSION, HOST_ONLY, NO_LOCAL_AVATAR, RATE_LIMITED, CAUSE_DEPTH, QUEUE_FULL, INVALID_POSITION, INVALID_DIRECTION, INVALID_TARGET, INVALID_AMOUNT, INVALID_OPTION, TARGET_GONE, FIRER_UNSUPPORTED, EXPLOSION_UNAVAILABLE, PROJECTILE_UNAVAILABLE, STATUS_UNAVAILABLE).
The explosion (a named explosion or a weapon name).
The event the action reacted to.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Only while waiting for assets.

fields: World position (an event position works as it is).
Mod id (defaults to the calling mod).

methods.name: spawn
methods.doc: Request a catalogued explosion at a position: a named explosion ('Hellbomb' = the NUX-223 Hellbomb, 'B-100 Portable Hellbomb'), or a weapon's catalogued explosion. Host only, in a mission, credited to the local player; loads the explosion's package first when needed. Unknown explosions, raw ids and unknown packages are refused.

methods.name: of
methods.doc: The weapon's catalogued explosion handle (impact, else expiry).

methods.name: prepare
methods.doc: Load the explosion assets now (status ready or waiting_for_assets).

methods.name: list
methods.returns: {name: string, weapon: string|nil, type: integer, source: "behavior"|"weapon", assets_known: boolean}[]
methods.doc: Every explosion hd2.explosions can request.

HD2Actions.doc: hd2.actions: what event scripts can make the game do.

methods.name: heal
methods.doc: Heal the local player (clamped to maximum health).

methods.name: status
methods.doc: Every action: available or blocked, with the reason.

HD2EquippedWeapon.doc: The item in a player's hand (a snapshot; treat it as read-only).
fields: The catalogued weapon, throwable or stratagem item; nil when the held entity is not catalogued (for example a stratagem ball).
The held entity's type (16 hex digits): the weapon resource.
primary or secondary (proven); support, held_item or unknown (inferred).
The game's raw inventory selection (1 primary, 2 secondary, ...).
Which way it flies (any non-zero length; Runtime normalises it).
Only the local player (the default): the projectile is fired and credited by the local player's avatar.
Mod id (defaults to the calling mod).

HD2Projectiles.doc: hd2.projectiles: fire a catalogued weapon projectile (docs/event-scripting.md).

methods.name: spawn
methods.doc: Fire the weapon's projectile from a position in a direction through the game's own projectile function. Host only, in a mission; fired and credited by the local player (each counts as a shot in the stats); loads the weapon's package first when needed. Other players may not see it.

methods.name: prepare
methods.doc: Load the projectile assets now (status ready or waiting_for_assets).

methods.name: list
methods.returns: {weapon: string, role: string, type: integer, assets_known: boolean}[]
methods.doc: Every projectile hd2.projectiles can fire.

fields: Buildup added (0 < buildup <= 1000, default 100). The status starts when the target's buildup reaches its susceptibility; strength and duration come from the status itself.
Mod id (defaults to the calling mod).

HD2StatusEffects.doc: hd2.status: apply a status a player weapon applies (docs/event-scripting.md).

methods.name: apply
methods.doc: Request a status on an entity through the game's own status request queue (the game checks the target can have it and routes it to the target's owner). Host only, in a mission; the local player instigates it. Only statuses a player weapon applies through its damage; strength is refused.

methods.name: list
methods.returns: {id: string, name: string, family: string, type: integer}[]
methods.doc: Every status hd2.status can apply.

functions.name: after
functions.doc: Run once after a delay in game seconds (fractions work; 0 = the next update tick; math.random(1, 10) gives a random delay). The timer belongs to the calling mod; scope=mission cancels it when the mission ends.

functions.name: every
functions.doc: Run repeatedly (at least 0.05 s apart). Missed intervals are skipped, never replayed.

functions.name: mod
functions.doc: The scripting context of one mod (the same object on every call). With no id: the calling mod (the SDK wrapper scope or the running callback); it refuses to guess.

functions.name: players
functions.doc: Every player in the session now.

functions.name: game_state
functions.doc: The game's state now (nil when it cannot be read).

explosions.assets: Loaded automatically (the weapon's package; a Hellbomb's stratagem package).

sideEffects: Each projectile counts as a shot in the local player's stats.

buildup.meaning: Buildup added; the status starts at the target's susceptibility threshold.

options.strength: refused: strength and duration are the status's own

unproven: Visual effect residency is inferred (the same statuses are applied by enemies and environments).

spawnEntity.reason: The generic spawn's parameters and replication are not proven.
